config.mode_evidence: Pinned README: 0 highest accuracy, 6 highest efficiency; source enables recoloring at <=1 and step5/text matching at <=0.
config.preprocessing: Unmodified upstream metadata_preprocessing; serial deep-copied Pool jobs, process-count override disabled only; source-derived manual bounds.
config.network: Unmodified original LOAM, 7 channels, 2 classes; strict original checkpoint load; eval; CUDA FP32; TF32 disabled; batch 1
config.padding: zeros bottom/right, no shortened strips, no overlap, no resizing
config.interface: Use actual upstream bitmap worker at crop_size=1024 and BasicDataset.preprocess(scale=1); same-size bilinear decoder interpolation then two-class argmax.
config.arbitration: Highest float32 foreground softmax probability among accepted masks; strict > update in legend order, ties lower index; no accepted class=255 unknown
config.control: Mode0 full-tile 72 DPI source inputs identical to previous mode6/strip trial; distinct from primary144DPI results.
config.evaluation: Import unchanged benchmark_10m_all.py sample/reference_grid/scores/save_grid; physical3km SHA256 blocks; reference!=255; literal .2/.4/.6/.8 classes; no averaging.
config.richfield_reference: Direct source PDF f/fs paths with clip/draw order, unchanged GeoPDF affine. Same-resolution source-center comparisons and 10m geospatial-center comparisons.
config.resource_policy: No process multiplication; serial layers; own exclusive gpu.lock per inference process, removed in finally. No host configuration or other-process changes.
config.predeclared_fallback: If CUDA FP32 canonical tile OOM, diagnose memory; never silently shorten context/change mode. Any adaptation separately logged before scoring.
